description: Provides a convenient set of default API additions for building .NET test projects based on xUnit.

Availability: .NET 11 and .NET 10

- CHANGED Target frameworks by adding .NET 11 (net11.0) and removing .NET 9 (net9.0), so the package now targets .NET 11 and .NET 10

# Breaking Changes
- .NET 9 consumers must target .NET 10 or later.
